piranport.book.name: Piran Port Navigation Manual
piranport.book.landing: A guide to ship rigging, weapons, cooking, aviation, combat buffs, and dungeon sorties. Craft it with a Book and an Aluminum Ingot.
piranport.book.cat.cooking.desc: Crops, processing stations, and naval cuisine.
piranport.book.cat.aviation.desc: Carrier aircraft, ground-attack toggles, and fire control.
piranport.book.intro.getting_started.p1: Welcome to Piran Port! Follow these steps and you'll be firing guns within half an hour:$(br)$(br)$(bold)1. Mine:$() Find $(item)Bauxite Ore$() on surfaces or in mountains. Breaking it drops $(item)Raw Aluminum$() (Silk Touch drops the ore itself). Smelt to get $(item)Aluminum Ingots$().$(br)$(bold)2. Gather Salt:$() Zombies occasionally drop $(item)Salt$(); the stable source is evaporating water above a lit furnace (see "Salt & Rice").
piranport.book.intro.getting_started.p2: $(bold)3. Craft a Core:$() Use aluminum + salt + wood to craft a $(item)Ship Core$(). Start with $(item)Small Ship Core$() — cheap and agile. You can upgrade later.$(br)$(bold)4. Equip Weapons:$() Put cannons, torpedo launchers, missile launchers, or aircraft on your hotbar, and keep matching ammo in your inventory. Drag fuel items onto the ship core to refuel it.$(br)$(bold)5. Transform & Fight:$() By default, $(bold)place the core in your offhand$() to automatically transform into a kansen. Hold a weapon or aircraft and $(bold)right-click$() to fire or launch. You can also switch to helmet mode in the config file (equip core in helmet armor slot).
piranport.book.intro.getting_started.p3: $(bold)Key Reference:$()$(br)$(item)R$() — Manual reload$(br)$(item)Tab$() — Switch ammo type$(br)$(item)U$() — Toggle fighter ground attack$(br)$(item)P$() — Single-target lock$(br)$(item)O$() — Add to lock list$(br)$(item)I$() — Clear all locks$(br)$(item)H$() — Auto-launch toggle$(br)$(item)Y$() — Toggle battlefield highlight$(br)$(item)J$() — Toggle hit/kill/miss messages$(br)$(item)9 / 0$() — Wire-guided torpedo steer left/right$(br)$(br)$(bold)Developers:$() F8 debug mode, N cooldown override (see Debug Mode entry).$(br)$(br)Don't worry if it's a lot — every feature has a detailed entry later. $(bold)Suggested reading order:$() Cannons → Torpedoes → Cooking → Aviation → Combat → Dungeons → Ruins → Arsenal.
piranport.book.intro.getting_started.p4: All keys above are rebindable in Controls settings under the $(bold)Piran Port$() category.
piranport.book.intro.overview.p1: Piran Port is a Warship Girls R themed mod. To begin, mine $(item)Bauxite Ore$() for $(item)Aluminum Ingots$() (drops $(item)Raw Aluminum$() without Silk Touch) and collect $(item)Salt$(). Craft a $(item)Ship Core$() — Small, Medium, Large, or Submarine — then put weapons on your hotbar and keep ammo in your inventory before sortie.
piranport.book.intro.overview.craft: Four ship core types available (Small/Medium/Large/Submarine). Larger cores hold more weapons and have higher load capacity. Each core has a different fuel capacity.
piranport.book.intro.overview.medium_cra: Medium cores provide more weapon slots and load capacity, suitable for versatile combat with multiple weapon types.
piranport.book.intro.overview.large_craf: Large cores offer maximum weapon slots and load capacity, capable of equipping heavy guns and full aviation squadrons.
piranport.book.intro.transform.p1: Ship cores support two transformation modes:$(br)$(br)$(bold)Offhand Mode (default):$() Place the ship core in your offhand to activate the rigging.$(br)$(bold)Helmet Mode:$() Equip the ship core in your helmet slot to activate the rigging.$(br)$(br)You can switch modes by editing the $(bold)shipCoreSlotMode$() option in $(bold)config/piranport-common.toml$() ('offhand' or 'helmet').$(br)$(br)Your speed decreases based on total equipment weight. Enhancement slots accept $(item)Armor Plates$() for bonus defense and extra weight.
piranport.book.intro.transform.p2: When a fueled core is in the configured slot, transformation starts automatically; removing the core or running out of fuel ends it automatically. While transformed, hold a cannon, torpedo launcher, missile launcher, or aircraft and $(bold)right-click$() to attack or launch. Drag enhancement items onto the ship core in your inventory to store them; right-click the core with an empty cursor to retrieve the last stored enhancement.
piranport.book.intro.fuel.p1: Ship Cores require $(item)Fuel$() to maintain transformation. Fuel can be added using: $(item)Coal$() (+1), $(item)Blaze Rod$() (+1), or $(item)Fuel$() item (+1). Place fuel items onto a Ship Core to refuel.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Fuel capacity:$()$(br)Small: 10 / Medium: 20 / Large: 30 / Submarine: 10$(br)$(br)Fuel is consumed by distance while transformed. When fuel runs out, transformation ends automatically. Aircraft tooltips show $(item)Fueled$() or $(item)Not Fueled$() status.
piranport.book.intro.skins.p1: $(item)Skin Cores$() change your character's appearance. $(bold)Shift+Right-click$() a Skin Core to equip the skin. $(bold)Shift+Right-click$() the same skin again to remove it (core is not consumed). Switching to a different skin returns the old core to your inventory and consumes the new one.$(br)$(br)Three Skin Cores are available (I/II/III), each with a unique appearance. Skin state is synced across all players.
piranport.book.intro.debug.p1: Debug tools are available for server operators and mod developers.$(br)$(br)$(bold)[F8] Debug Toggle:$() Toggle debug mode. When ON:$(br)- Detailed logging to $(item)logs/piranport-debug.log$(br)- Extra tooltip data (v₀, drag, gravity, dispersion) on cannons$(br)- Ammo/fuel is not consumed when in creative$(br)$(br)$(bold)[Shift+F8] Snapshot:$() Writes a full state dump to the debug log — transform status, weight, speed, buffs, fire control targets, and active aircraft.
piranport.book.intro.debug.p2: $(bold)[N] Cooldown Override:$() Forces all weapon cooldowns to 5 seconds for rapid testing.$(br)$(br)$(bold)[J] Hit Display:$() Toggles chat messages showing weapon hit/kill/miss results.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Creative Blueprint:$() A debug item that substitutes for any blueprint in the Weapon Workbench, useful for testing crafts at no cost.
piranport.book.cannons.basics.p1: Four gun types: $(item)Single Small Gun$() (1 barrel), $(item)Small Gun$() (twin 2 barrels), $(item)Medium Gun$() (1 barrel), $(item)Large Gun$() (triple 3 barrels). Barrel count determines ammo consumed per salvo.$(br)$(br)$(item)HE Shells$() cause area explosions. $(item)AP Shells$() deal higher armor-piercing damage.
piranport.book.cannons.basics.craft: Shells must match gun caliber. Unfilled medium/large guns show an empty durability bar as a reminder.
piranport.book.cannons.basics.medium: Medium guns use medium-caliber shells, suitable for medium-sized ships.
piranport.book.cannons.basics.large: Large guns are triple-mounted, consuming 3 large-caliber shells per salvo with devastating firepower.
piranport.book.cannons.basics.ops: $(bold)Switch Ammo [Tab]:$() Press Tab to open the ammo selection overlay. Move your mouse to pick between HE and AP shells (and special shells like VT/Sanshiki if available). Release Tab to confirm the selection.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Reload [R]:$() Press R to manually reload your current gun from ammo in your inventory.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Scope:$() Right-click while transformed to enter scope view — a zoomed first-person perspective with a crosshair for precision aiming.
piranport.book.cannons.advanced.p1: $(bold)VT Shell (Proximity Fuze):$() Small caliber only. Follows the same trajectory as HE shells but detonates automatically near the target. Effective against fast-moving targets.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Type 3 Shell (Sanshiki):$() Available in Small/Medium/Large caliber. Fires a spread of 64 pellets in a cone pattern. Each pellet deals 1/4 of the equivalent HE shell's damage. Effective against dense target groups or aircraft squadrons.
piranport.book.torpedoes.basics.p1: Torpedo launchers (Twin/Triple/Quad) fire 533mm or 610mm torpedoes in a spread pattern. Torpedoes travel across water surfaces and inflict the $(item)Flooding$() debuff on hit. They self-destruct after 1 minute if they miss.
piranport.book.torpedoes.basics.craft: Twin launcher fires 2 torpedoes in a ±3° spread. Larger launchers spread wider.
piranport.book.torpedoes.basics.triple_c: Triple torpedo launcher fires 3 torpedoes simultaneously with wider spread, effective against multiple targets.
piranport.book.torpedoes.basics.quad_cra: Quad torpedo launcher fires 4 torpedoes simultaneously with maximum spread angle and firepower density.
piranport.book.cooking.crops.p1: Eight crops can be grown: $(item)Tomato$(), $(item)Soybean$(), $(item)Chili$(), $(item)Onion$(), $(item)Rice$(), $(item)Lettuce$(), $(item)Garlic$(), and $(item)Pineapple$(). Seeds drop from tall grass or wandering traders. Plant on farmland; Rice grows in waterlogged soil.
piranport.book.cooking.crops.p2: Harvest crops when mature. Tomatoes, onions, rice, and other crops can be used to cook various dishes. Some crops can be ground into flour or powder using the stone mill for more complex recipes.
piranport.book.cooking.stations.p1: $(bold)Stone Mill:$() Right-click to open. Grind crops into flour, powder, and paste. Accepts up to 4 ingredients and produces 1-2 outputs.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Cutting Board:$() Right-click to place an ingredient, then right-click repeatedly to cut. Shift+right-click to retrieve.
piranport.book.cooking.stations.p2: $(bold)Cooking Pot:$() Place over a heat source (fire, campfire, magma, lava). Right-click to open GUI. Add ingredients; the pot cooks automatically when heated. Recipes combine 1-9 inputs into a single food output.
piranport.book.aviation.aircraft.p1: Six aircraft types: $(item)Fighter$() (hovers and fires bullets, 64 rounds), $(item)Dive Bomber$() (dives close and drops a bomb), $(item)Torpedo Bomber$() (fires torpedo at 20-30 blocks range), $(item)Level Bomber$() (drops bombs from 32 blocks above, 8 rounds), $(item)ASW Aircraft$() (drops depth charges, targets only submarines/aquatic mobs), and $(item)Recon Squadron$() (see Recon entry).
piranport.book.aviation.aircraft.p2: While transformed, hold an aircraft item and $(bold)right-click$() to launch it. Aircraft draw fuel and matching ammo from your inventory: $(item)Bullets$() for fighters, $(item)Aerial Bombs$() for bombers, and $(item)Aerial Torpedoes$() for torpedo bombers. Press $(bold)[U]$() to toggle whether fighters attack ground targets.
piranport.book.aviation.fire_control.p1: While transformed: $(bold)[P]$() locks crosshair target (80-block range); $(bold)[O]$() adds target; $(bold)[I]$() cancels all locks. Locked targets shown in top-right HUD. Press $(bold)[Y]$() to toggle battlefield highlight — your aircraft/torpedoes/bombs glow. Only visible to you.
piranport.book.aviation.recon.p1: The $(item)Recon Squadron$() is a non-combat aircraft used for scouting. It carries no weapons or ammo. After launching, press $(bold)[V]$() to enter recon view — your camera follows the aircraft in real time. Press $(bold)[V]$() again to exit. The recon plane force-loads chunks around it so you can see distant terrain. Useful for spotting enemy positions before committing to an attack.
piranport.book.cat.combat.desc: Combat effects, buff foods, and battlefield tactics.
piranport.book.combat.effects.p1: $(bold)Flooding:$() Applied by torpedo hits. Slows and damages the target over time.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Reload Boost:$() Shortens weapon cooldowns and bow/crossbow draw time to 0.9/0.8/0.7x at levels I-III. Obtained from food like $(item)Chicken Tatsuta$() or $(item)Torpedo Juice$().$(br)$(br)$(bold)Evasion:$() Grants a dodge chance (15-35% based on level) while transformed. Obtained from $(item)Tempura$() or $(item)Kvass$().$(br)$(br)$(bold)Flammable:$() Fire hazard debuff when loading aviation fuel (disabled by default in config).
piranport.book.combat.buff_foods.p1: $(item)Chicken Tatsuta$() — $(bold)Reload Boost I$() for 180s.$(br)$(br)$(item)Torpedo Juice$() — $(bold)Hunger II + Reload Boost II + Fire Resistance I$(); returns bottle.$(br)$(br)$(item)Tempura$() — $(bold)Evasion I$() for 180s.$(br)$(br)$(item)Kvass$() — $(bold)Slowness I + Slow Falling I + Evasion II$() for 120s; returns bottle.$(br)$(br)Cook these at the $(item)Cooking Pot$() using standard ingredients.
piranport.book.cooking.world_dishes.p1: The mod includes a rich variety of dishes from around the world, all crafted at the $(item)Cooking Pot$().$(br)$(br)$(bold)Chinese:$() $(item)Dongpo Pork$(), $(item)Deluxe Baozi$(), $(item)Tangyuan$(), $(item)Assorted Char Siu Fried Rice$()$(br)$(bold)Japanese:$() $(item)Soba Noodle$(), $(item)Tempura Soba$(), $(item)Yokan$()$(br)$(bold)German:$() $(item)Schweinshaxe$(), $(item)Thuringer Rostbratwurst$(), $(item)Thuringer Rostbratwurst und Bier$(), $(item)Weisswurst mit Bagel$(), $(item)Black Forest Gateau$()
piranport.book.cooking.world_dishes.p2: $(bold)Russian:$() $(item)Borscht$(), $(item)Okroshka$(), $(item)Russian Dumpling$(), $(item)Rye Bread$(), $(item)New Rye Bread$()$(br)$(bold)British:$() $(item)Yorkshire Pudding$(), $(item)Eggs Benedict$(), $(item)Black Tea Scone$(), $(item)Black Tea Sandwich$(), $(item)Royal Naval Salted Beef$()$(br)$(bold)Others:$() $(item)Bouillabaisse$(), $(item)Salami Pizza$(), $(item)Venice Cuttlefish Noodles$(), $(item)Macaron$(), $(item)Tarte Tatin$(), $(item)Double/Triple Shell Burger$(), $(item)Barbecue$(), etc.$(br)$(br)All dishes can be placed on the ground for shared eating.
piranport.book.cooking.salt_rice.p1: $(bold)Salt Evaporation:$() Place a $(item)Water Source$() block directly above a lit $(item)Furnace$(). After 10 seconds, the water converts to a $(item)Salt Block$(). Flowing water above a furnace produces $(item)Salt Chips$() instead.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Rice Paddies:$() $(item)Rice$() must be planted on waterlogged farmland — place water and plant rice seeds on the flooded block. If the water is removed, the crop breaks.$(br)$(br)Salt no longer generates naturally; furnace evaporation is the stable source.
piranport.book.cat.dungeon.desc: Sea area sorties and node-based combat.
piranport.book.dungeon.basics.p1: Obtain a $(item)Dungeon Key$() and find a $(item)Dungeon Lectern$(). Right-click the lectern with a key to open the sortie screen. Choose a chapter and stage, then press $(bold)Sortie$() to enter. Each stage has multiple nodes connected by $(item)Portals$(). Walk into a portal to advance to the next node.
piranport.book.dungeon.basics.p2: At each node, defeat all enemies to proceed. Collect supplies from $(item)Loot Ships$() along the way. If you fall in combat, you may revive by consuming a $(item)Totem of Undying$(), or give up and return to the lobby. Use a $(item)Town Scroll$() to exit the dungeon early. First clear of each stage grants bonus rewards. Your progress is saved on the $(item)Dungeon Key$().

message.piranport.ship_girl_greet: Hello, Admiral! How can I help?
message.piranport.ship_girl_patrol: I will keep watch nearby and intercept abyssal units that get too close.
message.piranport.ship_girl_abyssal: The abyssal fog feels wrong. Check your fuel and ammunition before sortieing.
message.piranport.ship_girl_supplies: If you are heading for ruins, bring supplies and lighting.
message.piranport.ship_girl_combat_on: I will actively engage nearby abyssal units.
message.piranport.ship_girl_combat_off: I will stay alert but avoid starting fights for now.
message.piranport.ship_girl_status: Status: %s / %s / durability %s/%s / rapport %s (%s). Use a command sword to cycle orders; sneak-use to toggle rules of engagement.
message.piranport.ship_girl_intel_turn_i: Intel received. I prepared an experience shell for equipment work.
message.piranport.ship_girl_supply_full: I am in good condition. Keep those supplies for the sortie team.
message.piranport.ship_girl_contract_no_: There is not enough space to assemble a ship girl here.
message.piranport.ship_girl_recruited: Contract confirmed. A ship girl joins port operations.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_int: The abyssal fog records are still incomplete. If you find an operation report, bring it to me first.
Sortieing without intel is too risky. Start with clues from abyssal units and ruins.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_pre: The route in the report is usable, but the sortie kit needs preparation. Bring an emergency repair kit.
A supply unit may still have repair tools. Bring fuel and it may trade.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_cal: Preparation is done; the route beacon still needs calibration. A portal activation core can stabilize the coordinates.
If the core is ready, hand it over and I will finish the final calibration.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_com: The joint route is stable. I can keep providing supplies, trade, and combat support.
The abyssal flagship will not simply wait. Prepare your equipment and sortie decisively.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_fol: The fog after a flagship sinks leaves a reverse wake. Bring the post-battle report and I can chart the next coordinate.
The abyssal flagship has clear phase changes. The fuller the review, the safer the next expedition.
If the flagship is down, do not discard the report. It contains long-term clues for abyssal-world operations.
The post-battle coordinate is still drifting. A chaos shard can anchor the residual beacon.
A shard is not just material. Stabilize its resonance before we turn it into expedition support.
I will write the shard frequency into port records so supply, recon, and maintenance can connect.
The final step needs any faction flag as a contact signal. A flag is not decoration; it is route authority.
Once the faction signal is established, abyssal actions can become long-term support instead of one-off sorties.
After you hand me a flag, support will be tracked as recon, maintenance, drill, air cover, research, and supply.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_bra: Long-term contact is established. Different supplies can now open support branches, not just one-time rewards.
Reports suit recon, repair kits suit maintenance, and experience shells suit drills. Do not treat every supply as plain loot.
Aviation fuel connects air cover, shards suit research, and flags can extend supply beacons.
Each branch is recorded the first time it is completed. Repeat deliveries still provide smaller support.
All six support branches are connected. This route is not merely passable now; it can be operated.
Recon, maintenance, drill, air cover, research, and supply are all filed. Next, tune equipment and formation until they feel natural.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_rap: Our rapport is high now. I can read your pause before firing, your reload rhythm, and your retreat route.
Port operations are not built on one victory. Return steadily, resupply steadily, sortie steadily. That is a long front.
Use the command sword if you need me to follow. If you need me to hold, I will treat this place as a temporary anchorage.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_fac: J-line rigging rewards clean launch motions: set the heading first, then smooth the deck wind.
The bow-style launch is not a pose. It folds sightline, wind, and sortie rhythm into one line.
Against fast abyssal units, do not chase damage alone. Lay flare and smoke first; hits become more reliable.
C-line rigging values array stability. When the talisman light rises, keep the formation from spreading too far.
I will mark the supply line on the near-sea side. You take the fire window; I will keep an exit open.
For an abyssal base, read the tide line before the enemy group. Good shelling comes from calm preparation.
G-line mechanical arrays like exact numbers. Turret speed, spread, and reload rhythm should be judged together.
Submarine routes need patience. In abyssal fog, the danger is not seeing the enemy; it is forgetting where you are.
If the trajectory looks wrong, check range and elevation first. Instinct helps, but records are steadier.
I-line catapult motions should feel light. Once aircraft leave deck, the next cycle should already be ready.
Supply matters as much as speed. Getting out is only the first step; returning with results completes the sortie.
Large-caliber guns announce your position. After firing, take a better angle.
E-line longbow motion needs lead. The farther the target, the less you can stare only at the center of the sight.
Sea fog can fool the eye, but not the record. Read impact point, smoke trail, and delayed sound together.
A carrier deck is not background decoration. Stable airspace gives the fleet another margin of safety.
F-line rigging favors diagonal thrusts. Do not press head-on forever; a new angle opens gaps in abyssal formations.
The rapier-style launch is about decisiveness: confirm, launch, reposition. Do not hesitate in one place for long.
Supply points inside abyssal bases matter. If you can take resources, do not only think about flattening walls.
U-line firearm launches are loud, but smoke and blast can also cut the sightline open again.
If the target is too far, watch the impact and correct. Shells tell the truth; they are simply loud about it.
Keep a fuel margin for carrier catapults. Emptying the last barrel makes retreat ugly.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_fol: I will follow your route and keep formation.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_hol: I will hold this position. Use the command sword if you need me to move.
message.piranport.ship_girl_dialogue_com: Rules of engagement are set to standby. I will not start fights on my own.
message.piranport.ship_girl_quest_not_re: That supply is not needed yet. Current joint operation: %s.
message.piranport.ship_girl_quest_intel_: Report analysis complete. Next, bring an emergency repair kit to prepare abyssal sortie equipment.
message.piranport.ship_girl_quest_prepar: Preparation complete. Finally, bring a portal activation core to calibrate the abyssal route beacon.
message.piranport.ship_girl_quest_comple: Route beacon stabilized. Take this contract and preparation material; I will support future port operations.
message.piranport.ship_girl_followup_not: That material is not needed yet. Current follow-up operation: %s.
message.piranport.ship_girl_followup_nee: There is no record of the abyssal flagship sinking yet. Defeat the flagship, then bring the post-battle report.
message.piranport.ship_girl_followup_fla: Flagship battle record reviewed. Next, bring a chaos shard to stabilize the residual coordinates.
message.piranport.ship_girl_followup_sha: Shard resonance stabilized. Finally, submit any faction flag to establish a long-term contact beacon.
message.piranport.ship_girl_followup_all: Contact beacon established. The port can keep organizing abyssal expedition support.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_statu: Support branches: %s/%s. Reports, repair kits, experience shells, aviation fuel, shards, and faction flags can open different cooperation paths.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_locke: Long-term cooperation is not complete yet (current: %s), so branch support is unavailable.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_recon: Recon branch established. Scout routes and abyssal nav data have been calibrated for the port.
Recon data updated. Additional scout reports are ready.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_maint: Maintenance branch established. Rigging damage logs have been filed and preparation material returned.
Maintenance logs synchronized. One experience shell has been returned.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_drill: Drill branch established. Armor and movement will be calibrated against combat tempo.
Drill data recorded. Some aluminum has been returned for equipment work.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_air_c: Air cover branch established. Carrier routes are now part of port support planning.
Air cover endurance refreshed. Carrier route data is ready.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_shard: Shard research branch established. Chaotic resonance has been stabilized into usable material.
Shard resonance recovered. Aluminum and preparation experience have been returned.
message.piranport.ship_girl_branch_allia: Alliance supply branch established. The contact beacon is now long-term support.
Alliance supplies received. Aviation fuel and repair tools have been returned.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_flagship_ph: The abyssal flagship changes formation. Escort ships are gathering.
The abyssal flagship enters decisive battle posture. Firepower and aircraft activity increase.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_flagship_ba: The abyssal flagship locks the area. Heavy shells are incoming.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_flagship_sh: The abyssal flagship releases a close-range shockwave.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_supply_hint: The abyssal supply unit makes a muffled sound. It seems willing to exchange abyssal reports, fuel, shards, flags, or experience shells.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_supply_inte: The abyssal supply unit reads the report and releases deep-sea supplies.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_supply_fuel: The abyssal supply unit accepts the fuel and returns an emergency repair kit.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_supply_shar: The abyssal supply unit consumes the shard and condenses aluminum with preparation experience.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_supply_flag: The abyssal supply unit recognizes the flag signal and returns aviation fuel with repair tools.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_supply_dril: The abyssal supply unit records drill data and returns an abyssal report with aviation fuel.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_archivist_h: The abyssal archivist taps a wet slate. It can decode reports, shards, paper bundles, or faction flags.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_archivist_r: The abyssal archivist indexes the report and sketches a route map with training data.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_archivist_s: The abyssal archivist stabilizes the shard resonance into reports and aluminum notes.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_archivist_p: The abyssal archivist needs at least 6 paper to bind a usable report.

message.piranport.deep_ocean_archivist_f: The abyssal archivist cross-references the faction signal and returns a shard sample.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_engineer_hi: The abyssal engineer taps an armor plate. It can process aluminum, repair kits, reports, fuel, or chaos shards.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_engineer_al: The abyssal engineer needs at least 8 raw aluminum to forge a repair kit.

message.piranport.deep_ocean_engineer_re: The abyssal engineer performs a fleet overhaul and reinforces %s nearby abyssal units.

message.piranport.deep_ocean_engineer_fu: The abyssal engineer fires a fuel furnace and smelts raw aluminum with redstone wiring.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_engineer_sh: The abyssal engineer compresses shard resonance into a repair frame, returning tools and aluminum.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_navigator_h: The abyssal navigator turns a wet compass. It can process abyssal reports, compasses, paper, aviation fuel, flags, or chaos shards.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_navigator_r: The abyssal navigator turns the report into a scouting route and marks %s nearby abyssal units.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_navigator_c: The abyssal navigator calibrates the compass and returns route maps with an old abyssal report.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_navigator_p: The abyssal navigator needs at least 8 paper to chart a usable route.
The abyssal navigator folds the paper bundle into a route map and leaves a calibrated compass.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_navigator_f: The abyssal navigator simulates deck wind with aviation fuel and returns flare and smoke supplies.
The abyssal navigator reads the flag signal and files a set of abyssal route records.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_navigator_s: The abyssal navigator compresses shard resonance into a heading beacon and marks %s nearby abyssal units.
message.piranport.deep_ocean_quartermast: The abyssal quartermaster taps a sealed ammunition crate. It can process abyssal reports, fuel, raw aluminum, experience shells, flags, or chaos shards.
The abyssal quartermaster breaks the report into a battle manifest and returns medium shells with smoke supplies.
The abyssal quartermaster routes fuel into aircraft preparation and returns aviation fuel with fighter ammunition.
The abyssal quartermaster needs at least 6 raw aluminum to pack a repair and ammunition kit.
The abyssal quartermaster presses raw aluminum into repair fittings and releases small-caliber shells.
The abyssal quartermaster records drill experience and returns combat preparation material.
The abyssal quartermaster confirms the faction supply signal and returns reports, aviation fuel, and repair tools.
The abyssal quartermaster stabilizes the shard into core supplies and reinforces %s nearby abyssal units.

piranport.book.cat.ruins.desc: Four types of ruin structures scattered across the ocean: Portal Ruins, Supply Depots, Outposts, and Abyssal Bases.
piranport.book.ruins.overview.p1: Across the ocean biomes, you will find four types of ruin structures.$(br)$(br)§lPortal Ruins§r — Ancient portal frames on the ocean floor. No enemies, but frame materials can be collected.$(br)§lSupply Depots§r — Small building remnants with light enemy guards and basic loot.
piranport.book.ruins.overview.p2: §lOutposts§r — Medium military facilities with runway structures, more abyssal NPCs, and richer loot.$(br)§lAbyssal Bases§r — Large bases found only in deep ocean biomes. Multiple runways, many high-level enemies, and the best loot and rare materials.$(br)$(br)Make sure to equip your rigging before exploring!
piranport.book.ruins.enemies.p1: The abyssal forces consist of 9 ship types:$(br)§lSupply§r — Harmless supply unit$(br)§lDestroyer§r — Fast light cannons$(br)§lLight Cruiser§r — Cannons + torpedoes$(br)§lHeavy Cruiser§r — Heavy guns + high armor$(br)§lBattle Cruiser§r — High-damage tracking shells
piranport.book.ruins.enemies.p2: §lBattleship§r — Strongest cannons + highest defense$(br)§lLight Carrier§r — Launches a few aircraft$(br)§lCarrier§r — Large aircraft squadrons$(br)§lSubmarine§r — Underwater stealth + torpedo attacks$(br)$(br)Abyssal NPCs have fleet alert AI — attacking one may alert the entire fleet!
piranport.book.ruins.loot.p1: Each ruin type contains different tiers of loot:$(br)$(br)§lPortal Ruins§r — Basic materials, some portal frame blocks$(br)§lSupply Depots§r — Small equipment, resources, flags, sortie channel (rare)$(br)§lOutposts§r — Medium/large equipment, aircraft, exp shells, chaos shards (rare)
piranport.book.ruins.loot.p2: §lAbyssal Bases§r — All tiers of equipment, abyssal reports, chaos shards, portal activation cores (rare)$(br)$(br)Chaos shards come in 9 varieties (α-ι), key materials for activating the deep sea portal in a future update. Flags can be used in skin crafting.

piranport.book.cat.arsenal.desc: Missiles, depth charges, special equipment, and weapon crafting facilities.
piranport.book.arsenal.missiles.p1: Missiles come in three types:$(br)$(br)$(bold)Anti-Ship Missiles:$() $(item)SY-1 Launcher$() (30 damage +6 AP, burst 2) and $(item)MK14 Harpoon Launcher$() (24 damage, burst 4). Right-click to launch; auto-tracks nearest target ahead (excludes underwater targets and containers), or tracks fire-control locked target.
piranport.book.arsenal.missiles.p2: $(bold)Anti-Air Missiles:$() $(item)Terrier Launcher$(), $(item)Sea Dart Launcher$(), $(item)Seacat Launcher$(). With $(bold)[H]$() auto-launch enabled, they auto-fire when airborne enemies are within 32 blocks, prioritizing fire-control locked targets.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Rockets:$() $(item)Ship Rocket Launcher$(), fires straight with no guidance.$(br)$(br)Unfilled launchers show an empty durability bar as a reminder.
piranport.book.arsenal.depth_charges.p1: $(item)Depth Charge Launchers$() deploy $(item)Depth Charges$() against underwater targets. Three models:$(br)$(br)$(bold)Depth Charge Launcher$() — 1 charge, single drop$(br)$(bold)DC Launcher Improved$() — 2 charges, fore-aft spread$(br)$(bold)DC Launcher Advanced$() — 3 charges, triangle spread$(br)$(br)Depth charges sink automatically and detonate via $(bold)proximity fuze$() when near a target, dealing area magic damage.
piranport.book.arsenal.special.p1: $(bold)Combat Items:$(br)$(item)Damage Control$() — Clears all debuffs and extinguishes fire$(br)$(item)Repair Kit$() — Hold right-click on a mob to continuously heal$(br)$(item)Smoke Candle$() — Deploys a smoke screen block$(br)$(item)Flare Launcher$() — Fires a flare that creates light on blocks, makes mobs glow on hit
piranport.book.arsenal.special.p2: $(bold)Special Weapons:$(br)$(item)Mysterious Weapon$() (Railgun) — Gravity-ignoring high-speed projectile$(br)$(item)Gungnir$() — Throwing weapon$(br)$(item)Eugen's Ship Shield$() — Blocks 150° frontal arc$(br)$(item)Hatsuyuki's Main Gun$() — Axe-type weapon$(br)$(br)$(bold)Equipment:$(br)$(item)Kirin-class Headband$() — Permanent invisibility$(br)$(item)Football Superstar Set$() (4-piece) — Experience Boost buff
piranport.book.arsenal.special.gungnir: Gungnir is a powerful throwing weapon that deals high damage to enemies.
piranport.book.arsenal.crafting.p1: $(bold)Weapon Workbench:$() Right-click to open GUI. 5 tabs (Cannons/Torpedo Launchers/Missile Launchers/Depth Charges/Aircraft). Select a recipe, insert materials, and click Craft. Some advanced weapons require $(item)Blueprints$(). Crafting takes time; collect the result when done.
piranport.book.arsenal.crafting.p2: $(bold)Ammo Workbench:$() Craft various ammo types (shells, torpedoes, missiles, depth charges).$(br)$(br)$(bold)Reload Facility:$() Insert an empty launcher and matching ammo to load it. Works with cannons, torpedo launchers, and missile launchers.
piranport.book.aviation.asw.p1: $(item)ASW Aircraft$() specialize in attacking underwater targets. Currently available: $(item)Swordfish Mk3$() and $(item)TBF (ASW)$().$(br)$(br)$(bold)Attack behavior:$() Only attacks submarines and aquatic mobs. Flies over the target and drops $(item)Depth Charges$().$(br)$(br)$(bold)Sonar detection:$() ASW aircraft scan for underwater entities every second. Detected targets are highlighted with a $(bold)yellow outline$(). Sonar highlighting is independent of fire-control and Y-key highlights.
piranport.book.torpedoes.named.p1: Multiple torpedo variants exist, each with unique damage, range, and speed.$(br)$(br)$(bold)533mm Series:$() Standard, Magnetic (magnetic fuze), Acoustic (homing), Wire-Guided (press $(bold)[9]/[0]$() to steer manually).$(br)$(br)$(bold)German G7 Series:$() G7a standard/magnetic, G7e electric magnetic/acoustic/wire-guided.
piranport.book.torpedoes.named.p2: $(bold)US MK Series:$() MK14 standard, MK16/MK17 hydrogen peroxide, MK27 acoustic.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Japanese Series:$() Type 91 610mm, Type 93 Mk1 high-speed / Mk3 long-range (oxygen torpedoes), Type 95 530mm/610mm submarine torpedoes, Type 0 720mm heavy torpedo.$(br)$(br)Hover over a torpedo item to view its specific damage/range/speed stats.
